description: (0.5.0) A witness quorum is counted only over a checkpoint the consumer has verified (RFC-ACDP-0015 §8 'Precondition: a verified checkpoint'), whether or not it otherwise checks log proofs. Checkpoint verification needs no receipt, so a cannot_verify inclusion does not block the quorum.

input.cosignature: A cosignature by a trusted witness (wit-001 key material)

scenarios.name: A — altered checkpoint, log-proof checking disabled

expected.behavior: The checkpoint's root_hash was altered after signing (log-004 tampering) and a cosignature over the altered triple verifies. The checkpoint is verified anyway and fails: not 1-witnessed, reported via invalid_log_proof — not invalid_witness_cosignature.
The checkpoint verifies and the trusted cosignature over it verifies: 1-witnessed. Inclusion is reported separately as cannot_verify.

notes: Behavioral; not executed by scripts/conformance-runner.py (no witness_test_keypair). Kept separate from wit-003, which is an executed golden vector.
